statement: For fixed integers c>=1 and b with gcd(b,c)=1, every affine echo family union_r {r+h(cr+b):h>=0} has logarithmic density. It is upper-logarithmically approximable by finite periodic subfamilies, so every finite union of such affine families also has logarithmic density. In particular, every infinite continuation of the positive-background binary amplifier with echo step Qr/2-1 converges and cannot refute Erdos #25.
closes: the full affine echo counterexample family
every finite mixture of coprime affine echo charts
infinite concatenations of the explicit positive-background binary amplifier
dependency_gaps: The density transfer invokes the published Davenport--Erdos theorem for sets of multiples.
No independent reconstruction has been performed in this campaign.
General conditional echoes need not be affine in their first active index.
It remains open whether every increasing least-representative system r_j modulo d_j with r_j<d_j<=C r_j has logarithmic density.
Neither the original public problem nor its full positive-limit case is closed.
